entryConclusion: PARTIAL; residual empirical test only, not initial terrain correction
radiometry: retained source-native B02 B03 B04, decode DN*0.0001-0.1; DN0 nodata, never PNG

sourceSun.role: documented scene/COG mean, not exact pixel Sun

method: one per-band empirical C residual normalization versus unchanged L2A control; explicit no-change remains valid
strata: retained SCL4 vegetation / SCL5 not-vegetated, assessed separately; not homogeneous material truth
eligibility: positive valid RGB, local incidence mu>=0.3, finite terrain and full 1km shadow-ray support; model-blocked cells excluded and not brightened
crossValidation: four fixed 500m quadrants of core, leave-one-quadrant-out; fit only on training cells within native stratum
minimumEvidence: at least100 eligible cells per stratum overall, each held-out fold>=20 eligible cells and training mu P95-P05>=0.2; otherwise stop INCONCLUSIVE without widening
parameterValidity: C=intercept/slope from rho=intercept+slope*mu; positive slope and C>=0, finite denominator, held-out cells not used to select method/angles; invalid fit returns no-change
gainBound: 0.5<=gain<=2 for eligible cells; cells outside bound remain unmodified and count as rejected, no clipping to hide failure
sensitivity: repeat azimuth +/-2 degrees and elevation +/-1 degree, engineering perturbations not uncertainty bounds; no fitted solar direction
criteria: held-out absolute brightness-versus-mu correlation and within-stratum spread must improve in at least3 of4 admissible folds
no new nodata/nonfinite values; no value clipping; original and excluded cells remain exact
report per-band gains, negative/over-unit values and fold failures, including low-signal behavior without lifting shadows
normalized local gradient/mean texture distribution compared with unchanged control; do not claim recovered detail
inspect fixed folds and full-core views with identical display transfer, reject visible halos/noise/colour inconsistency even if correlation improves
results must be stable in direction under predeclared Sun perturbations; contradictory folds/material proxies classify PARTIAL/NEGATIVE
decorrelation and visual preference alone do not establish physical accuracy
allowedConclusion: useful or unsuccessful residual normalization of this already-processed dated product, on eligible supported cells
upstreamCaution: local Sen2Cor terrain/BRDF parameters not retained; never assume uncorrected source; inability to attribute residual causally stays explicit
